Senses.Explanation: Seven piercings and eight holes describes unrestricted passage through situations: movement is not confined to one aperture or fixed route. Xueshan moves from the lone peak and ocean to seven piercings and eight holes in the crossroads. Yuanwu says Xuedou’s seeing has seven piercings and eight holes. Asked what follows when the Way is trodden, Tiantong Keqi answers “seven piercings and eight holes.” Wuzu Fayan permits seven piercings and eight holes if the assembly fails to recognize the teaching in the scene.
